answer: Assign each identity a random, rotating observation post it alone must cover: watch the onyx marker on the mesa at a set hour and report a transient signal only visible there, or log the shifting dune edge from its sector. Reports are cross-checked against neighbours whose posts overlap slightly. One operator running clones cannot be present at many scattered posts at once — missed or copied reports stand out and earn nothing, while an honest single agent simply shows up. Sybil scale then demands real distributed presence, not extra names.
